flavours.name: Ab's Weakness
flavours.description: Vanilla malt gelato with chocolate malt mud cake and chocolate fudge.
flavours.sensory: Malty, fudgy and cakey - a dense chocolate dessert in a scoop that wants something sharp or roasty beside it.

pairs.why: Fresh berry cuts through the mud cake like a choc-dipped strawberry.
Espresso bitterness turns the malt and fudge into a mocha.
Bitter orange and chocolate cake - a jaffa reset for a dense scoop.
Tart passionfruit keeps a very rich scoop from getting heavy.

flavours.name: Choc Hazelnut Crunch
flavours.description: Messinatella gelato with hazelnut topping and cone crunch.
flavours.sensory: Roasted hazelnut and milk chocolate with a waffle-cone crunch - rich and toasty, so it loves bitter or tart company.

pairs.why: Espresso and hazelnut - the classic Italian bar pairing.
Bitter orange gives choc-hazelnut a clean, jaffa-style edge.
Fresh berry brightens the roasted nut and chocolate.
Double down on the waffle-cone crunch.

flavours.name: Foxy Cleopatra
flavours.description: Yoghurt and coconut gelato with mango salsa.
flavours.sensory: Tangy yoghurt and soft coconut with juicy mango - a light, tropical scoop that bridges sorbets and richer gelato.

pairs.why: Passionfruit sharpens the mango into a full tropical cup.
Buttery macadamia gives the fruit something rich to lean on.
Coconut on coconut, with lychee adding a floral lift.
Two tangy yoghurt scoops - one berry, one tropical.

flavours.name: Gooey
flavours.description: Peanut butter gelato with white chocolate peanut fudge and peanut praline.
flavours.sensory: Salty-sweet peanut butter, fudgy and crunchy; very rich, so it needs a sharp fruit or bitter partner.

pairs.why: Peanut butter and berry - the PB&J cup.
Dark chocolate bitterness reins in the sweetness.
Roast meets roasted peanut, and the bitterness checks the fudge.
Tangy berry yoghurt for a creamier PB&J.

flavours.name: Have a Gay Old Time
flavours.description: Caramel and milk gelato with chocolate-coated biscuit crumbs.
flavours.sensory: Soft caramel and milky cream with chocolate biscuit crunch - sweet and comforting, best with a bitter or tart partner.

pairs.why: Espresso turns caramel and biscuit into an affogato.
Passionfruit's tang cuts the caramel sweetness.
Shares the chocolate-biscuit crunch for a cosy double.
Bitter orange and caramel - a sharp, marmalade-style lift.

flavours.name: Leche Al Passion
flavours.description: Passionfruit gelato with dulce de leche.
flavours.sensory: Tart passionfruit rippled with milky caramel - sweet and sour at once, like a passionfruit caramel slice.

pairs.why: Dark chocolate and passionfruit is a pastry-kitchen classic.
Coconut softens the tang into a full tropical cup.
Mango sorbet keeps it fruity and light.
Doubles the caramel for a richer, rounder cup.

flavours.name: Mr. Messina XXL
flavours.description: Fior di latte gelato with baked cheesecake, pretzel crust and pretzel fudge.
flavours.sensory: Creamy cheesecake with a salty pretzel crunch - rich, tangy-sweet and a little savoury; fruit is its best friend.

pairs.why: Berry on cheesecake - the obvious topping, in sorbet form.
Salted caramel picks up the pretzel's salty-sweet edge.
Passionfruit cheesecake, with tang to cut the richness.
Bitter orange keeps a big cheesecake scoop from tiring.

flavours.name: Nicpic
flavours.description: Milk chocolate gelato with rice crisp, peanuts, wafer and caramel.
flavours.sensory: A chocolate-bar scoop: milk chocolate, caramel and salty peanut with plenty of crunch; very sweet, so give it acid or roast.

pairs.why: Espresso bitterness tames the chocolate-bar sweetness.
Bright berry with peanut and chocolate - a fresh PB&J turn.
Sharp passionfruit cuts straight through the caramel.
Peanut and milk chocolate twice over, for the committed.

flavours.name: Red Velvet 2.0
flavours.description: Baked cheesecake gelato with red velvet cake and crushed red velvet fudge.
flavours.sensory: Tangy cream-cheese gelato with soft cocoa cake and fudge - rich and gently chocolatey, lovely beside berries.

pairs.why: Berry and cream cheese - the natural red velvet topping.
Deeper chocolate fills out the light cocoa of the cake.
Lemon-cheesecake vibes, and a sharp reset.
Tangy berry yoghurt echoes the cream-cheese tang.

flavours.name: Tres Leches V.2
flavours.description: Milk gelato with milk-soaked sponge and milk jam.
flavours.sensory: Milky, soft and caramel-sweet with soaked-cake texture - gentle and creamy, so it shines next to fruit or coffee.

pairs.why: Milk and espresso - a cafe con leche in two scoops.
Mango and tres leches is a Latin American favourite.
Strawberries on milk cake, fresh and light.
Shared milk jam, with passionfruit adding tang.
